from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single document regarding its citation relations."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being parsed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for parsing results from a single document."""
    papers: list[Paper]
